mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the pineal gland was most worthwhile: the planned day–night comparison shows both increased nighttime melatonin release and its suppression by light.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to add the retinal cells directly to the body was unproductive; the compatibility feedback did not explain why the existing eyes could not accept them yet.

surprise.text: The clock’s outgoing nerve route passes through the spinal cord and a nerve cluster in the neck before reaching the pineal gland, rather than taking a direct route within the brain.

arbitrary.text: Having to assemble the pathway separately before connecting it to the body felt somewhat arbitrary, given that the retinal cells were described as part of the existing eyes.

continue.text: I would continue: tracing a less familiar physiological pathway was interesting, although I would want more explanation of how the brain clock coordinates other organs.
